ModMetaData.name: Greater Krayt Dragon Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Mlie.StarWarsAnimalCollection's Greater Krayt Dragon art (primary look, south/east/north facings only - the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: Star Wars-named creatures keep their canon identity (the apex Tatooine desert predator), full regeneration, heavy black outline required. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/GreaterKraytDragon/GreaterKraytDragon_<facing>) the donor uses across all life stages, so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
